quote: 'Not doing great things, but little things with great love!'
blurb: TAMMANA is a Punjab-registered, Chandigarh-based, non-profit organisation founded on 1st September 2008 and working consistently for 18+ years towards the welfare of society. Founded and led by State Awardee Isha Kakaria, TAMMANA is powered by 40+ volunteers from diverse fields and backgrounds. Completely voluntary and without Government funding, the organisation conducts monthly events and social initiatives, offering membership opportunities and certified internships to those who wish to contribute towards meaningful change.
